LDRC2SIM-1.0.12: Firmware page shows an animated progress bar while an update downloads and flashes.
LDRC2SIM-1.0.11: Updates now also come from messiter.com (public OTA mirror), alongside the local dev server.
LDRC2SIM-1.0.10: Low-latency event-driven HID reports (sub-ms); Wi-Fi reconnect watchdog + mDNS restart.
LDRC2SIM-1.0.8: Remap channels page: feed any of 8 USB outputs from any of 16 RX inputs, per-output reverse; colour input bars; saved to NVS.
LDRC2SIM-1.0.6: Fix firmware-page hang, smoother channel bars, tidied text.
LDRC2SIM-1.0.5: Lower latency, async Wi-Fi scan, please-wait + firmware-page styling.
LDRC2SIM-1.1.0: Drive the simulator from your phone, like the RXV2 receiver does: new RealFlight and neXt buttons on the home page open a controls & views screen — RealFlight gets big Select/Cancel/Up/Down/Reset buttons (HID buttons 1-8, also fired by receiver channels 9-16, e.g. a TX switch on ch10 = Reset) plus its camera/view keys; neXt gets its own key set (New model, Engine, Pause...). The adapter is now a USB keyboard as well as a joystick, so the phone can send any simulator keyboard shortcut — all keys editable per simulator, saved on the phone. One re-calibration may be needed in the sim (the joystick gained buttons). On a Mac, allow the sim in System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Input Monitoring.
